# Peter Vanosdall, Realtor in Kailua, Oahu

> Peter Vanosdall is a licensed Hawaii real estate salesperson (RS-88081) with Hawaii LUX Homes of eXp Realty. He is based in Kailua on Oahu's Windward side and helps buyers and sellers across Oahu, including first-time buyers, mainland relocations, military PCS moves, and homeowners preparing to sell. He is also a landscape photographer and writes a monthly Oahu real estate newsletter.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Contact card, buyer home match quiz, free home valuation, newsletter, and social links.
- [Sell your home](/sell/): Free home valuation and seller consultation. Hawaii LUX Homes provides complimentary in-house staging on every listing, professional photography and video, team-wide promotion, and open houses. Includes Hawaii-specific seller notes on HARPTA withholding, conveyance tax, fee simple vs. leasehold, and seller disclosure.
- [About Peter](/about/): Background, who he helps, and team results.
- [Contact](/contact/): Message form for buying, selling, or relocation questions.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter/): Monthly Oahu market update, island life, and real estate tips.

## Key facts

- Team: Hawaii LUX Homes, brokerage eXp Realty.
- Team rankings (RealTrends Verified): #1 team in Kailua and #2 team in Hawaii by sales volume; about $127.8M in annual sales volume; 24 agents.
- Service area: All of Oahu, with a focus on Kailua and Windward Oahu.
